Olivia (People Ops): Heads-up — promo window closes next Friday 4/19 EOD PST. Please confirm evidence uploads: manager signoff + peer feedback link required. Any questions?
Mano (Eng Manager): Quick Q — we had a transfer on 3/15. Candidate moved teams. Can we backdate eligibility to new team for this cycle or do we use old manager's packet?
Lia (HRBP): Use the current manager for the submission, but include a short transfer memo from the prior manager for context (one bullet). That avoids re-running comps.
Mano (Eng Manager): Understood. Payroll cutoff question: if comp change is approved after cutoff, is retro pay automatic?
Sasha (Payroll): If approval timestamp is after payroll cutoff it goes into the next cycle and we issue retro pay. Cutoff for May 1 effective date is 4/25 11:59pm PT.
Jordan (Manager): For promotions that come with spot equity/refresher grants, who signs off on grants?
Olivia (People Ops): Equity ops handles grant issuance but manager initiates via the grant-request form. Include comp rationale + market comps. cc @Lia for any exceptions.
Mano (Eng Manager): I uploaded evidence to /shared/promos but got a permission error — what's the right place to store docs?
people-ops-bot: Permission required: request access via people-ops@redwood.com or click the Drive request link. (Link: https://drive.redwood/example)
Olivia (People Ops): We have a one-page evidence template pinned to the People Ops channel — suggested bullets: impact, scope, measurable outcomes, leadership examples, 2 peer quotes + 1 cross-functional endorsement. Use the manager's email as the submitter.
Lia (HRBP): Contractor -> FTE conversions are a bit different: eligibility depends on conversion date and hours worked. Send me the case and I’ll route the eligibility check.
Mano (Eng Manager): Thanks — I’ll finish the doc tonight. Any quick checklist I should run before submission?
Olivia (People Ops): Checklist: 1) Evidence doc (template) 2) Manager signoff 3) Peer feedback link 4) Comp recommendation and band 5) Submit in Workday via 'CompChange' flow. If cross-band, include market comp and business rationale.
Jordan (Manager): If we need a fast cross-band exception for a candidate we want to close this week, what’s the escalation path?
Olivia (People Ops): For urgent cross-band requests: email people-ops@redwood.com with subject 'URGENT: Cross-band exception' + business justification, recruiter note, and proposed comp. We triage within 48 hrs. :thumbsup:
Mano (Eng Manager): Great, thanks — pinging once I submit so payroll/salary ops can pre-check. :pray:
Sasha (Payroll): Please include the manager approval timestamp in the submission so payroll knows whether to hold for cutoff.
Olivia (People Ops): Also reminder — do not put PII in the evidence doc (SSN, bank info). If you need to attach sensitive docs, use the secure upload link.
Mano (Eng Manager): Noted. Thanks everyone!
